title: Standing on One Leg
benefits: Imagine you are a hyena laughing at all the other stupid aimals who have come to drink at the oasis
thumb2: thumb3Put your weight on one leg and lightly lift the other
placement: Inhale to prepare, exhale as you lift
movement: Don't go too fast. Keep your core engaged.
breath: If you have knee or ankle issues, move carefully and shorten the range.

title: Wall Roll Down
reps: Works your abdominals and spinal support muscles
benefits: Imagine peeling your spine off the wall one bead at a time
imagery: Stand with your back near the wall and feet a little forward
thumb1: Nod the chin and roll down slowly, then stack back up
thumb2: Exhale as you roll down, inhale at the bottom, exhale to return
thumb3: Keep the movement smooth and sequential.
placement: Avoid locking your knees or forcing the stretch.

title: Heel Slides
reps: Works your lower abdominals and hip stabilizers
works: Improves pelvic control and core coordination
benefits: Imagine your heel is gliding across ice
thumb2: thumb3Lie on your back with knees bent and feet grounded
thumb3: Slide one heel away, then draw it back in without rocking the pelvis
placement: Exhale as the leg slides away, inhale to return
movement: Keep the ribs soft and pelvis steady.
breath: Reduce the range if your back starts to arch.

title: Bridge March
reps: Works your glutes, hamstrings, and core stabilizers
works: Improves pelvic stability and single-leg control
benefits: Imagine balancing a tray across your hips
thumb2: thumb3Lift into a bridge with shoulders relaxed and knees parallel
thumb3: Hold the bridge and gently lift one foot at a time
placement: Inhale to prepare, exhale for each foot lift
movement: Keep both sides of the pelvis level.
breath: Lower out if you feel strain in your lower back.

title: Side-Lying Leg Lift
reps: Works your outer hips and waist stabilizers
works: Builds hip strength and pelvic control
benefits: Imagine your top leg reaching long through the heel
thumb2: thumb3Lie on your side in one long line with your waist gently lifted
thumb3: Lift the top leg up and lower with control
placement: Exhale to lift, inhale to lower
movement: Keep the leg slightly turned in to target the outer hip.
breath: Do not let the torso roll backward.

title: Wall Plank
reps: Works your shoulders, core, and chest support muscles
works: Improves posture, core endurance, and shoulder stability
benefits: Imagine pressing the wall away while growing taller
thumb2: thumb3Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height and step back
thumb3: Hold a long straight line from head to heels
placement: Breathe steadily and widen the back of the ribs
movement: Draw the belly in gently and keep the neck relaxed.
breath: Step closer to the wall if your wrists or shoulders feel overloaded.

title: Seated Spine Twist
reps: Works your obliques and postural muscles
works: Improves rotational mobility and upright posture
benefits: Imagine your spine spiraling upward like a tall ribbon
thumb2: thumb3Sit tall with legs comfortable and arms out to the sides
thumb3: Rotate from the waist to one side, return to center, then switch
placement: Exhale to twist, inhale to come back through center
movement: Keep both sitting bones grounded as you turn.
breath: Keep the twist gentle if you have back sensitivity.
